gizmo.title: Rārangi kohinga
gizmo.description: He tūemi āhua rārangi mō roto i tētahi rārangi kohinga, me te kupu, te hono, te ata tohu, ngā tūtohu, me tētahi whakaahua kōwhiri.

configure.title: Kupu kē
configure.description: Kupu kē e whakaahua ana i te whakaahua.

advanced.title: Ata tohu
advanced.description: Ata tohu e tohu ana i te rārangi.

advanced.title: Pānga kauruku
advanced.description: Huri i te kauruku o te whakaahua ina arotahi te kaiwhakamahi.

advanced.title: Ngā Tūtohu
advanced.description: Rārangi tūtohu kua wehea ki te piko.

advanced.title: Tae
advanced.description: Tae mō te ata tohu me ngā tūtohu.
